scheme_name: Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty
description:
The Scheme for Financial Assistance to Integrated Logistics Facilities: Reimbursement of Stamp Duty was launched by the Government of India on 1st April 2021.

This scheme is part of the broader initiative to enhance the logistics sector in India.

The logistics sector plays a crucial role in the Indian economy contributing approximately 13 to 14 percent to the country's GDP.

The primary objective of this scheme is to promote the establishment of integrated logistics facilities across the country.

The government aims to enhance the efficiency of the logistics sector by providing financial assistance to logistics service providers.

The scheme specifically targets the reimbursement of stamp duty paid during the acquisition of land for integrated logistics facilities.

The government has set a target to facilitate the establishment of at least 1,000 integrated logistics facilities by 2025.

The financial assistance provided under this scheme is aimed at reducing the overall cost of setting up these facilities.

The reimbursement of stamp duty is capped at 1 percent of the total value of the land purchased.

The maximum amount of reimbursement available under this scheme is ₹2 crores.

This financial assistance is expected to incentivize private sector investment in logistics infrastructure.

The scheme is applicable to all logistics service providers including private companies and public sector undertakings.

To be eligible for the assistance, the applicant must be a registered entity under the Companies Act 2013 or a partnership firm.

The applicant must also have a valid GST registration.

The land for which the stamp duty is being claimed must be used exclusively for logistics purposes.

The applicant must provide proof of payment of stamp duty along with the application.

The application process involves several steps.

First, the applicant must fill out the application form available on the official website of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

The application form requires details such as the name of the applicant, address, and GST number.

Next, the applicant must attach the required documents which include proof of land purchase and payment of stamp duty.

The applicant must also provide a copy of the GST registration certificate.

Once the application is complete, it must be submitted to the respective state government authority.

The state government will then verify the application and the attached documents.

Upon successful verification, the state government will forward the application to the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

The Ministry will process the application and approve the reimbursement.

The disbursement of the reimbursement amount will be made directly to the bank account of the applicant.

The timeline for processing applications is generally within 30 days from the date of submission.

The reimbursement is typically disbursed within 15 days after approval.

The scheme is implemented by the Department of Commerce under the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

For any queries or assistance, applicants can contact the Department of Commerce at their official helpline number.

The helpline number is available on the official website of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry.

The scheme is expected to significantly boost the logistics sector by encouraging the establishment of modern logistics facilities.

This will lead to improved supply chain efficiency and reduced logistics costs for businesses.

The government has also emphasized the importance of integrated logistics facilities in achieving the goal of 'Make in India'.

The scheme aligns with the National Logistics Policy which aims to create a robust logistics ecosystem in the country.

The logistics sector in India is projected to grow at a CAGR of 10.5 percent from 2020 to 2025.

This growth will be driven by the increasing demand for logistics services from various sectors including e-commerce, retail, and manufacturing.

The reimbursement of stamp duty is a critical financial support mechanism under this scheme.

It addresses one of the significant barriers to investment in logistics infrastructure.

The scheme is expected to create thousands of jobs in the logistics sector.

It will also contribute to the overall economic development of the regions where these facilities are established.

The government has allocated a budget of ₹1,000 crores for the implementation of this scheme over the next five years.

This budget will be used to reimburse stamp duty claims from eligible applicants.

The scheme is part of the government's larger vision to make India a global logistics hub.

The establishment of integrated logistics facilities will facilitate seamless movement of goods across the country.

This will enhance trade competitiveness and improve the ease of doing business in India.

The scheme is also expected to attract foreign direct investment in the logistics sector.

The government has recognized the need for modern logistics infrastructure to support the growing economy.

The reimbursement of stamp duty is just one of the many initiatives under the National Logistics Policy.

The policy aims to streamline logistics processes and reduce the logistics cost to GDP ratio from 13 to 9 percent by 2025.

The scheme for financial assistance to integrated logistics facilities is a vital step towards achieving this goal.

It reflects the government's commitment to improving the logistics landscape in India.

The scheme is expected to have a multiplier effect on the economy by enhancing logistics capabilities.

This will ultimately lead to better service delivery and customer satisfaction in various sectors.

The government encourages all eligible entities to take advantage of this scheme.

By doing so, they can contribute to the growth of the logistics sector and the economy as a whole.
